from collections import Counter

events = [
    ("alice", "click"),
    ("bob", "click"),
    ("alice", "view"),
    ("alice", "click"),
    ("carol", "view"),
    ("bob", "view"),
    ("alice", "view"),
    ("bob", "click"),
    ("carol", "click"),
    ("alice", "click"),
]

def clicks_per_user(ev):
    return dict(Counter(user for user, action in ev if action == "click"))

print(clicks_per_user(events))
